Metadata.title: Quina
Metadata.description: Organize your store's credit: every neighbor with their own terms, Quina calculates what they owe and collects for you.

Home.title: Your credit notebook, organized
Home.lead: We're getting your counter ready. Soon you'll be able to register your store and start giving credit with clear rules.

otp.subject: Your code to sign in to Quina
otp.intro: Use this code to confirm your email and keep setting up your store:
otp.outro: The code expires in 15 minutes. If you didn't ask for it, ignore this email.

reset.subject: Choose a new password for Quina
reset.intro: You asked to change the password of your Quina account. Tap the button to choose a new one:
reset.outro: The link expires in 30 minutes and can be used only once. If it wasn't you, do nothing: your password stays the same.

lockout.subject: We're protecting your Quina account
lockout.intro: There were 5 failed sign-in attempts on your account, so we locked it for 15 minutes.
lockout.outro: If it was you, wait 15 minutes and try again. If not, reset your password as soon as possible with "Forgot my password" to keep your account safe.

login.title: Sign in to your store
login.subtitle: Check your credit accounts and collect on time.
login.emailHint: Use the email you registered your account with.
login.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, number and symbol.

errors.nameRequired: Enter your full name (at least 2 letters) to identify the store owner.
errors.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.
errors.passwordRequired: Enter your password to sign in.
errors.passwordWeak: Use at least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, a number and a symbol.
errors.commercialNameRequired: Enter the commercial name of your business (at least 2 letters).
errors.businessTurnInvalid: Choose your business category from the list.
errors.taxIdInvalid: Enter the 11 digits of your RUC or the 8 digits of your DNI.
errors.otpInvalid: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to your email.
errors.otpExpired: The code expired. Request a new one with "Resend code".
errors.otpTooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Request a new code with "Resend code".
errors.userAlreadyExists: That email already has an account. Sign in.
errors.invalidCredentials: Email or password does not match. Check and try again.
errors.accountLocked: Account temporarily locked for security. Try again in 15 minutes or reset your password.
errors.accountDisabled: This account is disabled. Contact Quina support.
errors.taxIdTaken: That RUC or DNI is already registered to another store. Check the digits.
errors.emailTaken: That email is already registered to another store.
errors.captchaRequired: Complete the security check before continuing.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests in a row. Wait a few seconds and try again.
errors.generic: We couldn't complete the operation. Please try again in a few seconds.

account.title: Create your Quina account
account.subtitle: Start free with a 14-day Pro Trial. No credit card required.
account.nameHint: As shown on your ID. You will be registered as the store owner.
account.emailHint: We'll send a 6-digit code to confirm it.
account.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a number and a symbol.

strength.label: Password strength
strength.weak: Add characters to meet all password rules.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.subtitle: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. Enter it to continue.
verify.codeHint: Check your inbox or spam folder. The code expires in 15 minutes.
verify.resendCountdown: You can resend the code in {seconds} s
verify.resentNotice: We sent you a new code.

store.title: Your store details
store.subtitle: Last step: set up your store to start giving credit with clear rules.
store.commercialNameHint: The name your neighbors know you by (e.g. Bodega Don Lucho).
store.businessTurnHint: Choose the main activity of your store.
store.taxIdHint: Enter 11 digits for RUC or 8 digits if you operate with your DNI.

forgot.title: Recover your password
forgot.subtitle: We'll send a one-time link so you can choose a new password.
forgot.emailHint: Enter the email you use to sign in to Quina.
forgot.sentMessage: If the email entered is registered, you will receive a recovery link shortly

reset.title: Choose your new password
reset.subtitle: This link expires in 30 minutes and works only once.
reset.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a number and a symbol.
reset.invalidToken: This link was already used or expired. Request a new one to change your password.

Dashboard.subtitle: Start registering your neighbors and keeping clear accounts.

Profile.title: My profile
Profile.subtitle: Adjust your language and the email you use to sign in to Quina.
Profile.localeHint: Changes the language of screens and the emails you receive.
Profile.newEmailHint: We'll send a 6-digit code to the new email before changing it.
Profile.otpHint: Enter the 6 digits sent to your new email.

register.title: Start free with your first 15 neighbors
register.lead: No card, two minutes. Your store starts with 14 days of Bodega Pro.
register.point1: Each neighbor with their own limit, cut-off date and payment date.
register.point2: Quina works out what you are owed, with interest and late fees if you agree on them.
register.point3: Statements and reminders reach your neighbor’s email on their own.

login.title: Your credit notebook, in order
login.lead: What you are owed, up to date and without scribbles. Sign in and keep serving.
login.point1: Every credit sale is recorded with date, amount and who served it.
login.point2: Cut-off and payment dates are calculated for you.
login.point3: Collect without the awkwardness: Quina emails your neighbor.
